project_info.theme: Budweiser x Quán Nhậu Tự Do World Cup limited-edition gift giveaway poster
project_info.color_palette: Solid red, white, black, multicolor product accents

main_subject.detail: Promotional giveaway poster on solid red showing multiple limited-edition prizes including shirts, football, travel bag, glass set, and handheld fan, with a headline about buying Budweiser to get a chance to win gifts.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic product collage advertising, promotional campaign poster, clean e-commerce prize lineup

composition_elements.text: BIA CHÍNH THỨC CỦA FIFA WORLD CUP 2026™ / MUA 8 LON/CHAI HOẶC THÁP BUDWEISER NHẬN CƠ HỘI TRÚNG QUÀ TẶNG PHIÊN BẢN GIỚI HẠN / SET 2 LY BUDWEISER / ÁO THUN FIFA WORLD CUP / BÓNG ADIDAS FIFA WORLD CUP / TÚI DU LỊCH FIFA WORLD CUP / QUẠT CẦM TAY BUDWEISER / 09.07.2026 / 86 HỒNG TIẾN - LONG BIÊN - HÀ NỘI
items: Top Left: FIFA icon, Budweiser logo, and Quán Nhậu Tự Do co-branding row.
Top Right: Empty red negative space behind the large white headline.
Bottom Left: Prize lineup beginning with a Budweiser glass set box and two T-shirts.
Bottom Right: Travel bag, handheld fan, branded packaging, and legal drinking icons/disclaimer.
Center/Background: Adidas FIFA World Cup football and black presentation box placed among all giveaway items, with bottom date and location '09.07.2026 / 86 HỒNG TIẾN - LONG BIÊN - HÀ NỘI'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even commercial illumination, crisp product edges, clean retail poster readability

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Budweiser x Quán Nhậu Tự Do World Cup limited-edition gift giveaway poster. Centerpiece is a neatly arranged lineup of giveaway products including two shirts, an Adidas FIFA World Cup ball, a black Adidas box, a travel bag, a glass set, and a handheld fan on a solid red background. Background is minimal and branded for retail clarity. Surrounding elements: top co-branding row, exact headline 'MUA 8 LON/CHAI HOẶC THÁP BUDWEISER NHẬN CƠ HỘI TRÚNG QUÀ TẶNG PHIÊN BẢN GIỚI HẠN', prize labels across the middle, and bottom text '09.07.2026' and '86 HỒNG TIẾN - LONG BIÊN - HÀ NỘI'. Technical style: photorealistic product advertising photography, studio lighting, crisp product edges and readable retail composition, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
